integration_decision.improved_no_network_contract: At exact SHA, disposable overlay only: top-level spawn child A wraps runner.atomic_write_json (the imported alias, not storage.atomic_write_json) in A only, intercepting exactly once when Path(path).name == 'anata_latest.json'; set A_paused, block on release_A with bounded timeout. Parent waits A_paused, verifies A alive, pause-hit count=1 and A's latest.json/audit_latest.json exist while anata_latest.json absent; append one PIT-visible rowB (T=1700000000000, effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000), spawn independent B on same local_dir and same T; require B exit=0, archive/scoring=1/1, no source_errors, rowB provenance in B handoff; parse and save bytes of all three B output files. Before release, prove A is still alive and release_A unset; then release A in finally, join/terminate bounded, require A 0/0 and no errors, parse all final outputs. Compare final bytes against all three B snapshots. If latest/audit match B and anata differs with rowB missing, classify STALE_HANDOFF_REPRODUCED; any other mismatch classify OTHER_MIXED_GENERATION; all match means no overwrite in this controlled schedule; timeout/fixture/child errors are INVALID_TEST, not production proof. No sleeps, network, production changes, skipped/xfail assertions. Preserve collect-only, targeted, full Capital Flow pytest commands and exit codes.
